## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 75 captures during November 2019. Activity was completed through the site’s scheduled session lists, which ran as planned apart from routine leave. The overall capture total provides the activity measure for the month and indicates that imaging work continued across the reporting period. No operational interruption was identified beyond the routine leave noted in the site record.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. Of the 75 captures, 2 were ungradable. This produced an ungradable rate of 2.7. The ungradable images remain part of the monthly quality assessment and should continue to be monitored through routine review. The result provides a clear measure of the proportion of captures that could not proceed to grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results from the monthly activity. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading was completed within a short interval for the reporting period. Overall, the November 2019 results show completed activity, a recorded ungradable rate of 2.7, and 14 referable results, with a median lag of 1 day.
